include/docenhance/image/plane.hpp:clang.explanation: The one boundary where a plane's raw storage becomes samples, in a single private function. core::Buffer is over-aligned for every supported sample type, those types are implicit-lifetime, and the span covers whole rows, so no other cast is needed anywhere else in the project.

src/cli/run.cpp:clang-tidy/bugprone-exce.explanation: CLI11 parsing allocates standard containers, and parse_and_dispatch is called inside the adapter's sole exception boundary; MSVC's STL model otherwise attributes those caught allocation failures to this local record declaration.

The Windows CRT declares wmain with wchar_t**. The entry point preserves that ABI and only reads the arguments through a span before converting them to owned UTF-8 strings.

src/io/png_context.cpp:clang-tidy/cppcor.explanation: The C stream is owned by a unique_ptr with FileCloser. This line is its only release boundary (normal explicit close checks the result; the deleter is best-effort failure cleanup). The gsl-only owning-memory heuristic cannot express this C ABI deleter. Codec budget/failure and publication tests cover both paths.

Checked explicit close and RAII failure cleanup are exercised by codec/publication tests.

src/io/png_context.cpp:clang-tidy/misc-i.explanation: MSVC exposes the Windows-only _wfopen_s C runtime extension through implementation internals that clang's include cleaner cannot attribute to a usable direct header. This narrow adapter call is the sole native wide-path file-opening boundary; the Windows package and Unicode-path checks exercise it.

src/io/png_decode.cpp:clang-tidy/cert-er.explanation: libpng requires a setjmp return point for C codec errors. No non-trivial automatic owner lives in this jump frame: PngContext, file and Budget-backed allocations are constructed by the caller and destroyed normally after this function returns false. Malformed PNG and allocation-failure regressions exercise the jump paths.

src/io/png_decode.cpp:msvc/4611@eab8232f.explanation: MSVC warns for each libpng setjmp frame despite both decoder frames containing no automatic C++ object with a destructor. The warning state is restored immediately after each expression; malformed-input and allocation-failure tests exercise both jump paths.

src/io/publication.cpp:clang-tidy/misc-i.explanation: The Windows SDK exposes MoveFileExW and GetLastError through its required umbrella header, but clang's include cleaner cannot attribute either ABI entry point through that SDK layering. The private publication adapter is the only Windows API consumer.

MoveFileExW is the Windows-native atomic no-replace publication operation. Clang's include cleaner cannot map it through the required Windows SDK umbrella header; this one ABI call is exercised by the Windows native package test.

GetLastError obtains the outcome of the immediately preceding MoveFileExW call. Clang's include cleaner cannot map it through the required Windows SDK umbrella header; keeping this code-bound exception preserves native error reporting.

src/io/publication.cpp:clang-tidy/modern.explanation: The GNU renameat2/RENAME_NOREPLACE and Darwin renamex_np/RENAME_EXCL extensions are declared by the native stdio.h, not by the standard C++ <cstdio> interface. Including the actual native provider is required by include-cleaner and deliberately confines this OS API dependency to the private publication adapter.

src/methods/box_mean.cpp:clang-tidy/*-un.explanation: The kernel's innermost read, reached by a coordinate that image::reflect101_folded has already folded into the plane, so it is in range by construction. A checked access here is on the hot path of every filtered sample; the sanitize, tsan and fuzz presets run the whole suite with a hardened standard library, which checks exactly this access.

tests/support/architecture_cases.hpp:cla.explanation: Plane has an explicit post-move contract: empty dimensions and empty owned storage. This test deliberately inspects that specified empty state and checks kernel rejection. Generic move checkers treat calls other than empty() as invalid without modeling the custom contract; sanitizer/reference suites verify the actual lifetime and shape behavior.

tools/native_probe.cpp:clang-tidy/cppcor.explanation: This single allocation/deallocation call implements the external Leptonica C interception ABI on Windows. The library owns the raw result and releases it through the matching callback; a C++ owning return type cannot implement that ABI. The native probe checks that the interception hooks are actually used.
